pull.title: doc: fix up some release notes
pull.body:
`32.0` -> `32.1`.
Add some missing PR #s (needed if #36769 happens more).

events.body: The following sections might be updated with supplementary metadata relevant to reviewers and maintainers. ### External sites * Code coverage & benchmarks: https://corecheck.dev/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36773 * Ralph review https://git.fish.foo/bitcoin/bitcoin/pulls/36773#author-ralph ### Reviews See [the guideline](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-review) and [AI policy](https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/blob/master/doc/AI_POLICY.md) for information on the review process. A summary of reviews will appear here.

> Add some missing PR #s (needed if #36769 happens more).

I wondered about this. If we want the pull numbers in the text, there should be a dev note about this, possibly a linter. Not sure if this is worth it though?

>  If we want the pull numbers in the text, 

I think we do, because bitcoincore.org is setup to automatically generate links to each PR, from the release notes, i.e https://bitcoincore.org/en/releases/32.1/.

<details><summary>I guess something like this should lint it, if needed</summary>

```diff
diff --git a/doc/developer-notes.md b/doc/developer-notes.md
index 7e1e616..9120d60 100644
--- a/doc/developer-notes.md
+++ b/doc/developer-notes.md
@@ -1302,2 +1302,4 @@ Release notes should be added to a uniquely named release note file, such as
 `/doc/release-notes-remove-feature-foo.md`, to avoid conflicts between multiple PRs.
+Include the pull request number in the snippet, using `(#12345)` for a
+bitcoin/bitcoin PR or `(gui#123)` for a bitcoin-core/gui PR.
 All `release-notes*` files are merged into a single `release-notes-<version>.md` file prior to the release.
diff --git a/test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs b/test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs
index 9d53af2..cf328f7 100644
--- a/test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs
+++ b/test/lint/test_runner/src/lint_docs.rs
@@ -4,2 +4,3 @@
 
+use std::fs;
 use std::io::ErrorKind;
@@ -16,7 +17,5 @@ pub fn lint_doc_release_note_snippets() -> LintResult {
     ]))?;
-    if non_release_notes.is_empty() {
-        Ok(())
-    } else {
+    if !non_release_notes.is_empty() {
         println!("{non_release_notes}");
-        Err(r#"
+        return Err(r#"
 Release note snippets and other docs must be put into the doc/ folder directly.
@@ -27,4 +26,25 @@ be uniquely named and placed directly in the doc/ folder.
         .trim()
-        .to_string())
+        .to_string());
+    }
+
+    let snippets = check_output(git().args([
+        "ls-files",
+        "--",
+        ":(glob)doc/release-notes-*.md",
+        ":(exclude)doc/release-notes-empty-template.md",
+    ]))?;
+    let mut missing = Vec::new();
+    for path in snippets.lines() {
+        let note = fs::read_to_string(path).expect("must be able to read release note snippet");
+        if !note.contains("(#") && !note.contains("(gui#") {
+            missing.push(path);
+        }
+    }
+    if !missing.is_empty() {
+        return Err(format!(
+            "Release note snippets must mention their PR as (#12345) or (gui#123):\n{}",
+            missing.join("\n")
+        ));
     }
+    Ok(())
 }
diff --git a/test/lint/test_runner/src/main.rs b/test/lint/test_runner/src/main.rs
index 7c0eb58..9f7aecd 100644
--- a/test/lint/test_runner/src/main.rs
+++ b/test/lint/test_runner/src/main.rs
@@ -81,3 +81,3 @@ fn get_linter_list() -> Vec<&'static Linter> {
         &Linter {
-            description: "Check that release note snippets are in the right folder",
+            description: "Check the location and PR references of release note snippets",
             name: "doc_release_note_snippets",
```

</details>
